level_name: Slope as a rate of change

misconceptions.average-is-instant: Used the average over the whole interval as the rate at one instant.
misconceptions.change-not-rate: Gave the change in the quantity, not the rate (change per unit of time).
misconceptions.continuous-means-differentiable: Assumed an unbroken graph must have a derivative; corners don't.
misconceptions.corner-smooth: Called a corner smooth, but the one-sided slopes disagree.
misconceptions.dropped-cross-term: Expanded (p + h)² as p² + h², losing the 2ph term.
misconceptions.dropped-linear-term: Lost the derivative of the bx term.
misconceptions.early-substitution: Put h = 0 in before simplifying, which only ever gives 0/0.
misconceptions.forgot-to-divide: Simplified the numerator but didn't divide by h.
misconceptions.jump-continuous: Missed the jump: the two sides don't meet.
misconceptions.slopes-swapped: Swapped the left and right slopes.
misconceptions.units-flipped: Wrote the units of time per quantity, upside down.
misconceptions.units-no-time: Left out the 'per unit of time' that every rate has.
misconceptions.upside-down: Divided time by change instead of change by time.
misconceptions.value-not-function: Gave the derivative's value at one point instead of the function f′(x).
misconceptions.value-over-time: Divided the value by the time instead of the change by the elapsed time.
misconceptions.zero-over-zero: Stopped at 0/0, which is a reason to simplify, not an answer.
